utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, all. Anyone watch the football last night? Honestly, I could've had that on in the background and missed absolutely nothing.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Never mind that, whose new car's in the car park? Very shiny. Brave parking it next to the puddle.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not mine. Mine's the one where the dirt's doing structural work.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Protective coating, that. Engineering decision.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Thursday 06 August. Let's get going before this becomes a car valuation meeting.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Um, can you hear me properly? Teams has picked a different microphone again.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, you're fine. Bit hollow, but we can hear you.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cal, can you sort the permit to work and isolation for the spinner by Thursday? That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: By Thursday as in today, yeah? Not next week's Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, today. And first, because production's held up on it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, I'll sort the permit to work and isolation for the spinner. Today, first thing in my order.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, the permit and isolation together, not just the bit of paper.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, understood. Both. That's what I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: While we're on the urgent ones, I'll replace the seals on the feed pump this morning.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Ash. Top priority please.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll treat that as top priority. Seals on the feed pump, this morning.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Okay, so those are the two urgent bits, not everything on the list painted red.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. The spinner comes first for Cal; Ash has the seals as top priority. Different people, no clash there.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Oh, before filters get mixed up again, I already swapped the filter on the guard switch on two yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: The one on two? Yeah, I nearly read that as still open.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: No, finished yesterday. That's an update, not another one for today.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Different filter from me, then. I'll swap the filter on the IM1 hydraulic unit.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers, Grace Liu. Got you down for the IM1 hydraulic unit filter.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine. Not the guard switch one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I tested the big board yesterday and it's all fine now. While we're clearing the old stuff out.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, so that's finished, rather than something still hanging over us?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Finished, yeah. All fine now.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: stores Jamie, can you check the guarding on the new line tomorrow at 9:30?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, I'll check the guarding on the new line tomorrow at 9:30.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Tomorrow being Friday, just so nobody's looking at the wrong day on Teams.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yes, Friday at 9:30. That's the guarding check.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Understood. Not this morning. I've got the distinction.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah so, I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the air dryer today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Pricey. The air dryer sign-off is yours today.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yep, I'll do that today.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: And that's the sign-off you're talking about, rather than another filter job? Sorry, people were talking over each other my end.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: The lock-out tag-out sign-off, yeah. Filter was the finished one yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: On the blocked stuff, I can't get to the alarm box until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. Still blocked, then. We're not allocating an alarm box job today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Exactly. No window, so it stays where it is.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Same sort of story on the pump in the pit. Still waiting on parts, nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, can't fit parts that aren't here. Much as the schedule would like us to.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Quite. That's just the blocker carried over, not work I'm taking on today.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Separate from that, I saw the pressure on the pump in the pit dip for a few minutes. It came back on its own.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: It recovered without anyone doing anything?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah. Few minutes, then back. Just an observation, not adding a job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: I saw the pressure on the turbine one dip for a few minutes as well. That came back on its own too.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Mm. Two observations, then. Doesn't tell us they're related.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: No, exactly. Not drawing a conclusion or putting another task on anyone from that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I'll inspect the Boiler Feedwater Pump for leaks after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Cal, whenever you get a chance after lunch. That's not one to push ahead of the urgent stuff.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep. I'll inspect it after lunch, whenever I get a chance. Not treating it as urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Sorry, just keeping them straight in my head — Boiler Feedwater Pump inspection, not the feed pump seals?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's it. I'm inspecting the Boiler Feedwater Pump for leaks. Not taking the seals off Ash.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Definitely not. I'll replace the seals on the feed pump this morning, still top priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Has stores Jamie frozen, or is that a very convincing listening face?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Listening face. Rarely seen, apparently.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, anything unclear in what we've agreed?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No, that's clear. The finished bits stay finished and the blocked bits haven't magically become available.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. We'll leave it there, then. Cheers, everyone.
